source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The theorem conditions on an independent nuisance-training sample, assumes treatment-direction Hölder orders alpha and beta, includes an h^(alpha wedge beta) bias term, and derives the oracle rate in the discussed alpha <= beta, s >= d/4 regime.
The paper develops kernel-smoothed doubly robust estimation for the continuous-treatment dose-response curve, rather than a same-class unconditional minimax theorem.
The article proposes kernel-localized double-debiased/DML inference for continuous-treatment average dose-response functions and partial effects using an orthogonal moment and cross-fitting.
